d: Spain is witnessing widespread protests as millions of workers join a nationwide general strike over the country's worsening housing crisis. Protesters have set barricades on fire, smashed shop windows and clashed with police in cities including Barcelona, Madrid and Bilbao. The strike, backed by Spain's two biggest trade unions, is the first of its kind in 14 years. But what has pushed people to the streets? And can the government find a way out?
